title: Snapshot and publish scoped synthesis without scientific transition

handoff.objective: Snapshot and publish scoped synthesis without scientific transition
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Exact evidence custody and scoped independent review publication.
constraints: Zero scientific trials, formal builds, formalization runs, solver sweeps and benchmarks.
Preserve original sources, proof/specification/receipt bytes and existing statuses. No new EV/DEC/H records, scientific promotion, global lower bound, speedup or goal completion.
Only driving Coordinator performs Git, claims, publication, canonical queue updates and archive binding.
Missing custody/input/independence is an unresolved gate, never a mathematical negative or permission to fabricate an attestation.
Run alone; commit only exact declared source/archive artifacts, verify Git parent, diff scope and SHA-256s, then publish under ordinary gates.
No scientific ledger decision is authorized. These are snapshot archives only.
completion_gate: Record actual commit/parent/remote head/PR; do not invent publication or verification.
CHECKPOINT.json binds actual branch/PR/archive SHAs, reviewer IDs, open obligations and exactly one next_action under 1000 characters.
No goal-head edit, scientific lane closure, EV/DEC/H record or promotion; future official ledger act requires separate scope.
All exact declared artifacts present; actual commands, limitations and session provenance reported.
handoff.return_format: Artifact paths, checks, honest scope and unresolved gates.
